# Demo documents

Phone-photo style documents for showing Overlord live. Load them from **Sample photos** in the app, or upload them in
**Edit / Upload PDF**. Purchase orders and bills are read by the vision model (Gemma 4) into the editors.

## synthetic/ (generated by `make_samples.py`)

| Set | Purchase order | Bill / invoice | Goods receipt | Expected verdict |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1, team lunch | `set1_handwritten_po_team_lunch.jpg` (PO #7310, $60 cap, no service charge) | `set1_restaurant_bill_cafe_lido.jpg` (adds a 10% service charge, $66) | `set1_receipt_note_lunch_all_received.jpg` | Pay $60.00, hold $6.00 |
| 2, office chairs | `set2_handwritten_po_office_chairs.jpg` (6 chairs, $720, delivery included) | `set2_handwritten_invoice_office_chairs.jpg` (adds a $40 delivery fee, $760) | `set2_receipt_note_chairs_4_of_6.jpg` (4 boxes, 2 crossed out) | Pay $480.00, hold $280.00 |

The names, numbers and vendors are made up.

## real/ (CORD-v2)

Two restaurant receipts from the test split of [CORD-v2](https://huggingface.co/datasets/naver-clova-ix/cord-v2)
(Park et al., CC BY 4.0), each with its ground-truth parse. Amounts are Indonesian rupiah; the app reads them as plain
numbers. Gemma 4 read both totals exactly (91,000 and 174,600).
